explanations: Rounding each share on its own doesn't preserve the total: 100 split three ways rounds to 33 + 33 + 33 = 99, and 2 split three ways rounds to 1 + 1 + 1 = 3. A ledger needs debits to equal credits exactly, so the journal is rejected. The fix uses the largest remainder method: floor every exact share, then give the leftover cents, one each, to the shares with the largest fractional parts (ties to the earlier party, so the result is deterministic). The sum is then always exact and no share is off by more than one cent.
